short_description: Life Coverage Automated Applications - Erroneous Denials from Benefits Determination Service
detailed_description: The automated intake process for the new coverage program validates applicant eligibility by querying the Member Profile Service, which in turn proxies service-connection status from the downstream Benefits Determination Service (BDS). Recently, applicants with a granted rating decision from earlier in the enrollment cycle are being returned as having no qualifying rating, producing an erroneous denial at web submission. A member escalated by phone: applicant Gregory Halverson (SSN 512-04-9987, DOB 1979-03-14) was denied despite a granted rating; contact number on file is 555-0173-2245.

work_notes.author: SITEXAPRE
work_notes.note: MPS-7112 tracks our portion internally; this is a multi-partner effort with BDS engaged as well. IPT meets biweekly. BDS deployed an omnibus fix in the December release resolving most of the original defect (MPS-5601, Zero% Service-Connected mapping issue). Residual legacy-record analysis split into MPS-7112 and remains in analysis.

work_notes.author: Priya Sundaram (BDSHQSUNDP)
work_notes.note: Increasing priority - beneficiaries are being denied coverage who should be eligible.

work_notes.author: SITEXAPRE
work_notes.note: Current understanding: Member Profile acts as a proxy to BDS for eligibility and does not alter the downstream response. The BDS endpoints were not originally intended for eligibility lookups and the backing data was not fully migrated to support that use. Different BDS endpoints can return divergent results. IPT owns tracking of cause, impact, and remediation.

closure_information.resolution_notes: BDS tested and deployed the resolution in the weekend release; this ticket to Member Profile requested that approval/clearance, which has been granted.

short_description: Beneficiaries Denied Service Connected Rating 0% From Member Profile
detailed_description: Expected vs actual behavior when checking eligibility in the Coverage web application via Member Profile. Beneficiaries reported as eligible in the Benefits Determination Service are receiving an ineligible result from Member Profile. Expected: GIVEN a qualified applicant with a Service-Connected Rating of 0% AND Service-Connected = TRUE, THEN eligible. Actual: same conditions return NOT eligible. A set of affected internal ParticipantIds is retained in the related ticket (withheld here due to PII).

detailed_description: Requesting an audit history on a member record. The address displayed in the Care CRM was incorrect and did not match the clinical record of truth; the member reports never having resided at the address, which was later confirmed to be a vacant parcel. The CRM subsequently self-corrected, but an audit is requested to determine the original source of the bad value.

work_notes.author: SITEXAPRE
work_notes.note: Resolution Note - A bad address update was submitted to Member Profile in the spring; we rejected the update and no override was sent to force it. We have only ever returned the valid address, so the erroneous value did not originate from us. The consuming application should investigate which upstream partner surfaced it (an enrollment service appears to have forwarded updates from another partner).

work_notes.author: SITEXAPRE
work_notes.note: Spoke with the requester over chat. The member is Franklin Ortega, member registry ID 1004872910V335071, DOB 1961-11-02. The incorrect address on file was 4471 Sablewood Ter, Lot 12, Meridian FL 33540. Our DB has retained the same valid addresses since 2019. Awaiting requester return to confirm and close.

work_notes.author: SITEXAPRE
work_notes.note: Requested a valid registry ID so audit history can be returned. Noted that partners can query their own history via API rather than pinging us directly.

closure_information.resolution_notes: Bad address was submitted in spring but rejected; no override forced. We have retained valid addresses since 2019. Consuming application should investigate the source window.

short_description: Member DOB displaying incorrectly in EHR Chart View
detailed_description: Application Impacted: EHR Chart View. Member date of birth is displaying incorrectly in the chart but appears correct in the identity source and clinical record of truth. Issue reported as leaving member demographic information in an inconsistent state across systems.

work_notes.author: SITEXAPRE
work_notes.note: Taking the requester's suggestion and closing as unresolved - cannot reproduce.

work_notes.author: SITEXAPRE
work_notes.note: No attachments visible and we were only assigned this ticket yesterday. Member Profile is a proxy for anything other than address/email/phone (the only attributes we master), so we would not be storing or mastering DOB. At most we forward DOB from downstream partners in response to a demographic request. With no stored data and no member registry ID, we cannot query audit records. Given the age of the ticket and the lack of identifiers, there is nothing actionable to offer.
